content: परिघः .²1 An iron (or wooden) beam or bar used for locking or shutting a gate (अर्गल); एकः कृत्स्नां नगरपरिघप्रांशुबाहुर्भुनक्ति <ls>Ś. 2. 16</ls>; <ls>R. 16. 84</ls>; <ls>Śi. 19. 32</ls>; <ls>M. 5. 2</ls>. .²2 (Hence) A bar, barrier, hindrance, obstacle; भार्गवस्य सुकृतोऽपि सोऽभवत् स्वर्गमार्गपरिघो दुरत्ययः <ls>R. 11. 88</ls>. .²3 A stick or club studded or tipped with iron; पादपाविद्धपरिघः <ls>R. 12. 73</ls>. .²4 An iron club in general. It is a kind of weapon (परितो हन्तीती--सर्वतः कण्टकितो लोहदण्डः <ab>com.</ab> on <ls>Mb. 1. 19. 17</ls>); … … हन्तुं घोरं परिघमाददे <ls>Śiva B. 14. 99</ls>. .²5 A water-jar, pitcher. .²6 A glass-pitcher. .²7 A house, dwelling. .²8 Killing, destroying. .²9 Striking, a stroke or blow. .²10 A child which assumes a peculiar cross position in birth. .²11 A line of clouds crossing the sun at sunrise or sunset. .²12 The gate of a palace, town or house. Hence perhaps it means ‘Gate-duty’; मूलं भागो व्याजी परिघः कॢप्तं रूपिकमत्ययश्चाय-मुखम् <ls>Kau. A. 2. 6. 24</ls>. .²13 (In <ab>astrol.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of the 19th Yoga. .{@-घौ@} {%m.%} (<ab>du.</ab>) Two birds flying on each side of a traveller (regarded as an omen).
